;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**In the town of Dangdala, [[Chad]], 23 [[Military of Chad|National Army]] soldiers are killed in an overnight attack by [[Boko Haram]] militants. [https://af.reuters.com/article/chadNews/idAFL8N2192A4 (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*Global investment management company [[BlackRock]] says that it is buying [[eFront]], the leading provider of management software for alternative investments, for $1.3 billion in cash. [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/blackrock-to-acquire-efront-for-13-billion-in-cash-2019-03-22?mod=newsviewer_click (MarketWatch)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Two buses collide head-on in a village near [[Kintampo, Ghana]], killing at least 50 people. Almost all casualties are a result of a fire on one of the buses. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-47668146 (BBC News)] [https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/NewsArchive/Accident-claims-close-to-60-lives-at-Amoma-Nkwanta-near-Kintampo-732366# (GhanaWeb)]
*[[2018–19 Australian region cyclone season]]
**Thousands have been forced to evacuate their homes as two potentially devastating cyclones are expected to hit the country this weekend. [[2018–19 Australian region cyclone season#Severe Tropical Cyclone Trevor|Cyclone Trevor]] will make landfall in the north near [[Numbulwar]] and [[Borroloola]], while [[2018–19 Australian region cyclone season#Severe Tropical Cyclone Veronica|Cyclone Veronica]], a Category 4 storm, will strike [[Pilbara]] on Australia's west coast. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-47671306 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Yancheng chemical plant explosion]]
**Officials report the death toll is now 62 from Thursday's chemical plant explosion in Chenjiagang Industrial Park in northeastern [[Jiangsu|Jiangsu Province]], with 94 others seriously injured and 28 people still missing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47663023 (BBC News)] [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/death-toll-from-east-china-factory-blast-jumps-to-44-state-media (''The Straits Times'')]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–United States relations]], [[China–United States relations]]
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] removes sanctions targeting North Korea that were imposed Thursday by the Treasury Department on  two Chinese companies. [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/trump-surprises-by-revoking-north-korea-sanctions-immediately-after-treasury-imposes-them (Fox News)]
* The [[Inter-American Development Bank]],  Latin America’s largest development lender, cancels its scheduled  annual 48-country  meeting next week  following China's refusal to allow a  representative of [[Venezuela]]n opposition leader [[Juan Guaidó]] to attend what would have been  the first IADB meeting held  in China. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-china-iadb-exclusi/exclusive-iadb-cancels-china-meeting-after-beijing-bars-venezuela-representative-idUSKCN1R32NU?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Zaoyang car attack]]
**A man is shot dead in the city of [[Zaoyang]], [[China]], after ramming his vehicle into a crowd of pedestrians, killing at least six and injuring seven others. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/car-plows-into-crowd-in-china-six-killed-police-shoot-driver/ar-BBV4XBY?li=BBnb7Kz (MSN)]
*[[Mueller special counsel investigation|Special Counsel investigation]], [[Links between Trump associates and Russian officials]]
**Special Counsel [[Robert Mueller]] delivers  a report on his inquiry into [[Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections|Russian interference in the 2016 elections]] to Attorney General [[William Barr]], who is expected to summarize the findings for [[United States Congress|congressional lawmakers]] in the coming days. [https://www.cbsnews.com/live-news/mueller-report-released-russia-investigation-trump-campaign-election-live-updates-today/ (CBS News)] [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/special-counsel-robert-muellers-highly-anticipated-report-handed/story?id=61147281&cid=clicksource_4380645_null_headlines (ABC News)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/mueller-sends-report-trump-investigation-ag-barr-n974006 (NBC News)] [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/mueller-submits-russia-report/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
** More than 24 hours after the [[Bolivarian Intelligence Service]] (SEBIN) detain attorney [[Roberto Marrero]]—[[Juan Guaidó]]'s chief of staff—there has been no contact with him and lawmakers are denied access to him at [[El Helicoide]]. [http://talcualdigital.com/index.php/2019/03/22/advierten-que-a-marrero-le-podrian-aplicar-sustancias-para-dar-falso-testimonio/  (Tal Cual Digital)]
** Just hours after Marrero's detention, the [[United States Department of the Treasury]] responds by placing sanctions on [[BANDES]], the Venezuelan Economic and Social Development Bank and four of its subsidiaries. [https://www.france24.com/en/20190322-us-slaps-sanctions-venezuelan-bank (France 24)])
*[[2019 Algerian protests]]
**Hundreds of thousands of [[Algeria]]ns again rally, this week in heavy rain and cold weather, against [[President of Algeria|President]] [[Abdelaziz Bouteflika]] demanding his  immediate resignation.  Bouteflika is fighting for his political survival in the face of unrelenting protests and the desertion of long-time allies. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-algeria-protests/hundreds-of-thousands-of-algerians-rally-against-bouteflika-idUSKCN1R31B3?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Sports
*The [[English Football League]] is to deduct [[Birmingham City F.C.]] nine points for breaching profitability and sustainability rules. Birmingham City are the first club to be deducted points since the EFL introduced its new profitability and sustainability regulations in 2016. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/47667742 (BBC Sport)]
